snippet.title: Tattered Banners Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Tattered Banners http://s.team/a/1355900
Our Discord https://discord.gg/PCFuTKC

Lead your mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a living, simulated world shaped by your actions. Raid, bribe, steal, spy, assassinate, lay siege, and more - and watch the consequences ripple through and change a realm at war.

Recruit, equip, and train your mercenary company to survive in a harsh, fully simulated realm, where cities rise and fall, noble houses scheme for power, and every decision can mean profit, glory, or death.
